summary: INTG-007 makes encrypted envelopes the only persisted/decodable copy of organization social OAuth credentials. The organization OAuth callback now writes encrypted-only rows (no access_token/refresh_token), the token vault is encrypted-only and fail-closed, and the additive migration 20260921000000 (authored, NOT applied) revokes client column SELECT on organization_social_integrations.access_token/refresh_token and nulls existing plaintext.
